gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrence and pathologically confirmed WHO Grade IV glioblastoma (GBM);

candidate_evidence.quote: For patients with relapsed GBM, before receiving electric field treatment, the patient can be re-operated, and TTFields+BPC chemotherapy is used after surgery

agents.agent_name_registered: BPC chemotherapy (second-line chemotherapy given with TTFields)

role_evidence.quote: designed to explore the efficacy and safety of Tumor-Treating Fields (TTFields) combined with second-line chemotherapy treatment in recurrent glioblastoma multiforme (GBM)

coder_notes: Device trial (TTFields); chemotherapy is unnamed and given to all patients as background, so no pharmacological candidate. Registry phase is NA. The only registered intervention is a combination product (device).
